summary: Ravalli County, MT crow's nest and log cabin dated to the 1920s in the Bitterroot NF; listed Abandoned, and Rex's page says the crow's nest is still there with the cabin in ruins.

facts.design: crow's nest with a log cabin
facts.status_note: Rex's page says the crow's nest is still there and the log cabin is in ruins (note undated); the Association's list says Abandoned

corrections.why: The Association's list gives 'Crowsnest Abandoned', which our record mapped to gone. Rex's page says the crow's nest is still there and the log cabin is in ruins, so gone overstates the loss.

evidence.supports: about 8 miles south of West Fork Ranger Station
evidence.quote: 8 miles south of West Fork R.S.

evidence.supports: crow's nest and log cabin dated to the 1920s
evidence.quote: 1920s: crows nest (still there), log cabin. Ruins.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record had gone (from the Association's 'Abandoned') and standing (from our firelookout.com list scrape). Rex's detail page says the crow's nest is still there and the log cabin is in ruins, so the story uses ruins.

notes_for_editor: Status is the open call. The Association lists it Abandoned; Rex's page describes the crow's nest as still there and the cabin in ruins, with no date on that note. 'Ruins' is the nearest word in the status vocabulary, though the vocabulary means footings or remains only, and a standing crow's nest may be more than that. Our scraper maps FFLA 'Abandoned' to 'gone'; other records may be affected, so worth checking. Our firelookout.com list scrape marked the tower standing, which the detail page does not support. No staffing, fire or construction-date facts in the sources read; the 1920s date is decade-only, so no built event was added. The 2014 photo in the record was not checked and is not new.
